rules.subject: waiting_room
rules.rationale: A patient who comes in from the street reaches the waiting room first, without crossing any clinical space.
exceptions: Clinics in a larger building that share an upstream lobby

rules.subject: reception
rules.rationale: Reception sees the waiting room so staff can greet patients, notice a patient in distress and control who goes through to the clinical side.
exceptions: Self check-in kiosks replacing a staffed desk

rules.subject: exam_room
rules.rationale: Every exam room has its own door onto a clinical corridor, so patients called from the waiting room and clinicians moving between rooms never pass through another exam room.
exceptions: Dual-door rooms with a separate staff door

rules.subject: exam_room
rules.rationale: Patient privacy: what is said and done in an exam or consult room must not be heard or seen from the waiting room, so their doors do not open onto it.
exceptions: Minor-injury bays that open from a shared treatment hall

rules.subject: staff_zone
rules.rationale: Public, staff and service flows are kept apart: the staff room and staff respite are not entered from the waiting room, and staff reach the clinical side without crossing the public side.
exceptions: A small clinic with a single door for everyone

rules.subject: nurse_station
rules.rationale: The nurse station or team base sits among the exam rooms it serves, so staff supervise, restock and chart with the shortest walk.
exceptions: Very small clinics where the exam rooms share one support alcove

rules.subject: clean_supply
rules.rationale: Exam rooms are restocked many times a day, so clean supply sits beside the nurse station on the staff side of the clinic.
exceptions: Supply carts or cabinets in each exam room replace a central room

rules.subject: soiled_utility
rules.rationale: Clean and dirty (soiled) utility rooms are separate rooms that do not open into each other, so used instruments and waste never cross stocked supplies.
exceptions: A one-way pass-through between the two rooms

rules.subject: soiled_utility
rules.rationale: Waste and soiled material leave the clinic by a service route and never through the waiting room or the main entry.

rules.subject: patient_restroom
rules.rationale: A patient restroom opens off the waiting area, so people can reach it without going through the exam zone.
exceptions: A second restroom inside the exam zone for patients mid-visit

rules.subject: procedure_room
rules.condition: the clinic does minor procedures or sedation
rules.rationale: A patient who has had a procedure is moved a short way to recover, so the recovery area sits next to the procedure room and on the staff side.

rules.subject: medication_room
rules.rationale: The medication room holds controlled stock, so it is entered from the staff side and not from the waiting room.

rules.subject: clinical_corridor
rules.condition: wide enough for a wheelchair and a person passing
rules.rationale: The clinical corridor is wide enough for a wheelchair or a bed and a person to pass; the figure comes from the brief or the local code, which this pack does not state.
